title: Payoneer — outlook.fr template and Thailand Linux farm, sessions created vs verified
subtitle: Follow-up to DETCORE-4466. Source ARK_PROD.events.mini_events_log (session_setup + game_verify), exact counts by flag definition, back-filled before the flags existed.

signals.title: outlook.fr CamelCase name + random suffix, email ML 80+
signals.why: Capitalised US first + last name with a random 5-10 character suffix @outlook.fr (e.g. CharlesAlexanderu25778jf, PamelaBaker4E79816), email ML score 80-100. Windows Chrome 156 from CO/KR/NZ/TH IPs. Near zero until Oct 22, then 100-400 a day across CLM and Login, effectively 100% verified.

telltales.telltale_description: Templated outlook.fr registrations: CamelCase US first + last name with a random 5-10 character suffix, email ML score 80-100. Windows Chrome 156 from CO/KR/NZ/TH IPs. Started ~Oct 22 on CLM + Login, ~1.5k sessions/week, 100% verified.
telltales.external_description: Automated pattern: templated outlook.fr email handles (capitalised name + random suffix) with high email-risk score. Payoneer CLM and Login since Oct 22.

signals.title: Thailand + Linux desktop + hotmail, language 'th', Mesa/Renoir GPU
signals.why: Thai IPs, GNU/Linux Chrome 154-156, hotmail, browser language exactly 'th', GPU Mesa Intel or AMD Renoir. Handles are random Western names + birthdate or digits (e.g. shakyagardner23082002, alysahloxley3598). Absent before Oct 15, then a steady 60-210 a day on each key, 93-99% verified.

telltales.telltale_description: Thailand Linux desktop farm: GNU/Linux Chrome 154-156, hotmail, browser language 'th', Mesa Intel / AMD Renoir GPU, name-generator handles. Started Oct 15 on CLM + Login, ~2k sessions/week, 96% verified.
telltales.external_description: Suspicious device cluster: Linux desktops in Thailand with identical language and GPU profile registering hotmail accounts with generated names. Payoneer CLM and Login since Oct 15.
